title.narrative: Engie Energy Access Solar mini-grid Benin

description.narrative: Norad will co-finance with Engie Energy Access (by way of the local branch Engie PowerCorner Benin) the commissioning of a solar mini-grid in Dohouè, leading to both the growth of the local economy and incomegenerating activities in addition to the provision of electricity to the community improving its quality of life (e.g. lightening, entertainment, etc). Among the productive activities, the project expects to accompany the growth of the local palm nut processing industry, which employs mainly women. At the end of the project, 1 000 people will have a newly created electricity connection, and more than 100 women workers of the palm nut industry will see their job improved.
